title: Degree-zero stage comparison is injective
statement: In the filtered colimit-of-sites setting of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites], with compatible abelian sheaves, pullback cohomology maps satisfying the degree-zero unit formulas of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback], and the canonical degree-zero group diagram D and cocone c at a fixed stage object, the induced homomorphism colimit.desc D c from the group colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] to degree-zero object cohomology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] is injective.

source.place: Tag 09YP, using Sites 09YN and the right-exact diagram of Tag 0739

proof.text: Represent a kernel element in the filtered group colimit at a stage. Use Arrow endpoint transport to transfer its vanishing cocone image to the composite canonical cohomology map and system cocone map. Evaluate the degree-zero class on the identity generator; naturality and the assumed canonical-map unit formula show its section image in K is zero.

Apply varying-site section zero detection. Use the assumed stage-map unit formula and evaluation naturality to show the later cohomology transition has zero section. Injectivity of evaluation makes the later class itself zero. Arrow transport then makes the D transition zero, and the colimit transition equation makes the original kernel element zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YP, degree zero; sections via Sites 09YN and 0A35
proof_origin.note: S2: complete Lean Ext-to-sections and colimit-kernel argument; fixed-site outer sections proved; inner inverse-image step split off
